body_markdown:
Seaboard Marine is pleased to announce the latest expansion of our service network with the addition of San Antonio, Chile. This strategic enhancement further solidifies our commitment to providing unparalleled ocean transportation services between Chile, the United States, Central America, and the Caribbean basin.


With a longstanding history of serving Chile, Seaboard Marine has continually adapted to meet the evolving needs of shippers in the region. Our extensive expertise in refrigerated cargo transport has earned us a stellar reputation as the premier choice for moving perishable goods from the West Coast of South America to the United States, Central America, and the Caribbean basin. This new direct service to/from San Antonio will provide our customers with faster transit times, enhanced connectivity, and improved logistics solutions for dry and refrigerated cargo.


Piero Buitano, Regional Vice President, said, “Our decision to add San Antonio to our network reaffirms our dedication to providing efficient and reliable service to Chilean exporters and importers. Seaboard Marine has a proven track record of excellence in refrigerated cargo transport, and this expansion enhances our ability to deliver fresh and frozen goods with the highest standards of care and efficiency. We look forward to strengthening our partnerships in Chile and continuing to provide industry-leading ocean transportation solutions.”


Seaboard Marine’s expansion to San Antonio will further streamline logistics for customers shipping fruits, seafood, frozen meats, and other time-sensitive cargo to and from the region. With our state-of-the-art refrigerated container fleet and dedicated customer support, we continue to set the standard for temperature-controlled shipping across the Americas.


As we embark on this new chapter, Seaboard Marine remains steadfast in its commitment to excellence, reliability, and innovation in regional shipping. We are excited about the opportunities this expanded service will bring and look forward to continuing our strong relationship with the Chilean market.


For more information about our new service to San Antonio, Chile, please get in touch with your Seaboard Marine representative.
